messages:
john_cust: Hi team — invoice INV-2025-239 failed to charge repeatedly. Customer reports they complete 3DS but payment still shows 'authentication_required'. Seen twice this morning. 🤦

alex_support: Sorry about that, @john_cust. Can you paste the invoice link and the payment method last4? I'll pull gateway logs.

john_cust: link: https://app.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2025-239 payment method: card ending 8881. Customer tried twice, then tried a different card (ending 4242) and got a 'card_declined - insufficient_funds' error.

alex_support: Got it. I'm seeing two different failure codes in our processor: `three_d_secure_required` then `insufficient_funds`. On the 3DS attempts the gateway shows an auth timeout (SCA timeout) — looks like the challenge window closed before completion.

maya_billing: FYI this customer also has a PO on file (PO# 9821) and asked us not to retry card until PO is processed. Could that be related?

raj_fraud: From fraud side I'm seeing a soft decline flagged for velocity on the 8881 card (multiple recent attempts across merchants). Processor applied an automated risk hold after two retries.

alex_support: Summary: (1) 3DS attempt timed out — likely user closed the challenge or network blip, (2) second card attempt returned insufficient_funds, (3) fraud hold triggered by retries.

oliver_eng: Quick repro steps I ran: attempted a staged payment to a sandbox token and forced a 3DS flow — saw same `SCA_TIMEOUT` if the challenge isn't completed within 60s. Our hosted payment page shows the 3DS iframe; if the merchant page navigates away it cancels.

alex_support: Recommended customer-facing actions: 1) Ask customer to use a different card or retry from the hosted checkout (do not recommend bypassing SCA). 2) If they need immediate processing and have PO, coordinate with finance to accept PO then mark invoice as paid manually once PO clears. 3) If they want us to retry, we need explicit permission and to clear the fraud hold first.

maya_billing: I'll ping finance to prioritise PO#9821. @raj_fraud can you clear the risk hold if finance confirms PO?

raj_fraud: Yes — once finance confirms PO and we get a written OK from the customer for a retry, I can lift the automated hold and allow a one-time retry with monitoring.

alex_support: Internal action items: - maya_billing open finance ticket and update invoice notes. - oliver_eng add a short note to hosted checkout to prevent premature navigation during 3DS (UX nudge). - raj_fraud standby to clear hold after PO confirmation.

john_cust: Thanks — I'll tell the customer to try the hosted checkout and also push finance on the PO. Please keep me updated. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-239 status changed: payment_failed -> pending_action (PO pending). Event id: evt_8ZxP.

alex_support: Closing loop here — will update thread once finance confirms PO or customer retries successfully. If you hit a reproducible SCA timeout >3 times across customers let us know and we'll escalate to infra.
